prediction_policy: Reuse each method and receiver's real-training visit-5/8 line prediction from the sealed profile result; do not refit with held or control values.
objective: Ordinary profiled coherence of each held even-Qin frame at the fixed prediction residual.

control.name: symbol_qpsk_phase_scramble
control.derivation: For each candidate ID and frame index, SHA-256(seed:candidate_id:frame_index) seeds PCG64; draw one of four unit QPSK phases independently for each even-Qin symbol and apply it equally to all eight tones.
control.nuisance_justification: The waveform profile eliminates one static complex gain per tone. A symbol-varying phase shared across tones cannot be represented by those static per-tone gains and destroys the coherent frequency trajectory while retaining sample magnitudes.
